questions.prompt: A sector of radius 10 cm has an arc length of 10π cm. What is its angle in degrees?
A circular pizza of radius 15 cm is cut into 6 equal slices. Find the area and crust length of one slice, using π ≈ 3.14.
questions.modelAnswer: Each slice has angle 360 ÷ 6 = 60°, which is 1/6 of the pizza. Area = ⅙ × 3.14 × 15² = ⅙ × 706.5 ≈ 117.75 cm². Crust (arc) = ⅙ × 2 × 3.14 × 15 = 15.7 cm.
